• Mr. X tries to flee the detectives pursuit.
• The detectives try to find and catch Mr. X.
• The detectives win, if they move to the same station as Mr. X.
• Mr. X wins, if he does not get caught until final round.

" Detectives
 • Team of up to 5 players.
 • Moves on the gameboard are visible to all players.
 • Try to surround and catch Mr. X.

 Mr. X
 • One player.
 • Position only visible for himself (most of the time).
"

Players can traverse the gameboard trough:
• Walking → short distance, widespread
• E-Scooter → medium distance
• Car-Sharing → long distance, limited availability
Each station on the board has its one transport options assigned, trough which they can be reached.

1. Mr. X´s turn:
• Consumes tickets (Black and Double, others are unlimited).
• Selects station to which he wants to move.
• Which ticket was used will be shown to the detectives.
• Position stays mostly hidden.
In predetermined rounds, Mr. X's position gets revealed to the detectives.

2. Detective's turn:
• Can move concurrently.
• Expend tickets (Walking, E-Scooter, Car-Sharing)
• Can view the ticket use history of Mr. X.

Each player has the following tickets:
• Walking
• E-Scooter
• Car-Sharing

Special tickets of Mr. X:
• Black Ticket → transport option stays hidden
• Double Move → take two turns in one round
• Detectives have no special tickets.\n• A move is only possible, if the correct ticket is available.\n

A game ends, if:
• A detective catches Mr. X → detectives win.
• Mr. X evades capture → Mr. X wins.
• No detective can move → Mr. X wins.
